text:
Maria (Finance): Heads up — nightly billing job created ~120 invoices where the platform fee line is 0. Not in Stripe, looks like it dropped during the Stripe -> NetSuite sync. Anyone on call?
Dan (Payments): ugh, on it. any common order attributes? subscription vs one-off? :eyes:
Maria (Finance): mostly subscription charges, tiered usage. I pulled a sample webhook payload where amount_total looks right in Stripe but NetSuite invoice shows no fee line.
Raj (Reconciler): saw something similar on staging after the streaming webhook refactor last week. suspect a field rename in the webhook payload. We changed fee_amount -> fee.amount cents -> maybe our parser expects `fee_in_cents`?
Jen (Ops): I'm pulling DLQ and the webhook replay queue now. If it's a schema mismatch, replaying won't help until we patch the transformer.
Dan (Payments): sharing a quick snippet of the raw Stripe event we got:
```
{"id":"evt_1JXxxX","data":{"object":{"lines":{"data":[{"type":"subscription","amount":1500},{"type":"platform_fee","amount":150}]},"amount_total":1650}}}
```
Maria (Finance): and NetSuite invoice export shows: `line items: subscription 15.00` (no platform fee line)
Raj (Reconciler): confirmed — our webhook ingestion code dropped lines where `type` != `charge` after that refactor because we were deduping by `charge_id`. platform_fee lines lost.
Dan (Payments): that explains it. I'll open a hotfix to stop filtering out non-charge lines and add an explicit mapping for `platform_fee` -> NS line.
Jen (Ops): any immediate mitigation? Can we backfill affected invoices? We'll need to create credit memos or credit lines if invoice already posted to NS.
Maria (Finance): For the affected invoices (list exported to S3), finance prefers issuing a correcting invoice rather than editing posted invoices. We need runbook and approval from Finance Approvals.
Finance Approvals: please include estimated $ impact and a dry-run plan.
Dan (Payments): estimate ~120 invoices * $1.50 fee avg = ~$180. I'll prepare a dry-run script that reconstructs the missing fee lines and produces a preview CSV before any NS writes.
Raj (Reconciler): I'll add a guard in the webhook processor to fail loudly (500) when encountering unknown line types so they get sent to DLQ instead of being silently dropped.
Jen (Ops): provisional rollback plan: revert streaming change and replay safe events to catch backfilled lines after patch. Will coordinate maintenance window if NS writes needed.
Maria (Finance): ok — prioritize safety. Dan, can you post the dry-run output here when ready? We'll need signoff. :+1:
Dan (Payments): will post by EOD. patch PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/payments/pull/653 (contains mapping + test vectors).
billing-bot: Alert: nightly-billing-job failed 12 retries while replaying DLQ (rate limit). Putting replay on hold until patch is deployed. :rotating_light:
Maria (Finance): thanks. Finance Approvals — pinging for approval once dry-run looks good. Also need GL mapping for platform_fee -> NS account `Other Income:Platform Fees` (code 4102).
Finance Approvals: please attach the dry-run CSV and the runbook steps, we can review quickly.
Raj (Reconciler): note for the runbook: 1) run dry-run, 2) review preview CSV, 3) run in `ns-sandbox`, 4) once verified, run in production during low-traffic window, 5) monitor reconciliation job for a couple cycles.
Maria (Finance): Sounds good. tagging @Finance Approvals again.
Dan (Payments): dry-run posted to S3: s3://redwood-billing/dryruns/1728453901-fee-backfill-preview.csv 
Maria (Finance): I reviewed the preview — looks correct. Approving runbook contingent on ops scheduling the window.
Jen (Ops): scheduling for 02:00 PT maintenance window tomorrow. I'll coordinate NS sandbox test tonight.
Finance Approvals: approved. please proceed with the dry-run then production backfill during the scheduled window.
Maria (Finance): thanks everyone. Following up tomorrow for confirmation. :white_check_mark:
